text: We tested whether compound X reduces cytokine Y secretion in human monocytes. Compound X inhibited Y secretion by 62% at 10 uM (p=0.003, triplicate).

Results Monocytes treated with 10 uM compound X secreted 38 pg/mL of cytokine Y, compared with 100 pg/mL in vehicle controls. Dose response showed an IC50 of 4.2 uM, with no loss of viability at up to 30 uM.
Discussion These data support a dose-dependent inhibitory effect, although the mechanism remains unknown.
